significance: A small temple beside the Qutb complex in Mehrauli, held to be the only shrine of pre-sultanate origin in Delhi still in worship. It is the Hindu focus of the city's interfaith Phool Walon Ki Sair procession.
story: Yogmaya is said to have taken the place of the infant Krishna when Kansa tried to kill him, slipping from his grasp to foretell his death.
